analyzed_vuln.description: Use-after-free in reverse hash iteration during destructor shutdown: zend_hash_reverse_apply() stores a Bucket* (p = ht->arData + idx), calls user-influenced apply_func (zval_call_destructor), and then may call _zend_hash_del_el(ht, ..., p). The destructor callback can mutate $GLOBALS and trigger zend_hash_do_resize(), which reallocates/frees ht->arData. After that, the saved p is stale, but _zend_hash_del_el dereferences it (p->h / p->key), causing UAF. Crash manifests in _zend_hash_del_el at zend_hash.c:1518, but the root cause is iterator invalidation in zend_hash_reverse_apply not handling rehash/resize during callback reentrancy.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: During request shutdown, shutdown_destructors() calls zend_hash_reverse_apply(&EG(symbol_table), zval_call_destructor). A destructor with side effects (PoC: __destruct writes many new entries into $GLOBALS in a loop) grows EG(symbol_table), causing zend_hash_add_new -> _zend_hash_add_or_update_i -> zend_hash_do_resize to free/reallocate arData while reverse_apply is mid-iteration. reverse_apply then continues using previously captured Bucket* and deletes that element, triggering UAF read.
